influences.name: Oasis
influences.context: While we were living in London, my father would listen to a lot of Oasis and he introduced me to Amy Winehouse

influences.name: Amy Winehouse
influences.context: While we were living in London, my father would listen to a lot of Oasis and he introduced me to Amy Winehouse

influences.name: Grandfather (violinist)
influences.context: I grew up being around my Grandpa a lot—he was a violinist and my favorite person in the entire world. I was like this tiny baby following him around everywhere and doing everything that he did until I was like, Oh I want to start playing the violin.

influences.name: Mother (musician)
influences.context: my mum is also a musician; she majored in the flute and minored in the piccolo. I grew up in a household of music.

influences.name: Billie Eilish
influences.context: I think I was heavily influenced by Billie Eilish's new album while making Hi-Fi. With her and her brother, it's so interesting and inspiring to know they created a Grammy-winning fucking award album in their bedroom.

influences.name: Banks
influences.context: The music is significantly different, like you have artists like Banks and Billie Eilish. I think I want to emulate that sort of music rather than kpop, and so I think in that sense it's affected my artistry.

influences.name: BTS
influences.context: I am a huge fan of BTS. I still try to stay into those groups and make sure that I continue to listen to K-pop because it's something that I enjoyed as a kid and it's a part of my culture that I think is really empowering.

influences.name: My grandpa
influences.context: My grandpa, who was a violinist, was my absolute hero growing up. I followed him everywhere, doing everything that he did…we were inseparable! Watching him play the violin with such passion is what sparked my love for music.

influences.name: Seventeen
influences.context: Number 2 is Seventeen. They have such a dynamic and unique sound! I truly think they've created their own special corner of the K-pop industry…I'm so proud of them for finally receiving their well deserved Artist of the Year at MAMA this year!

influences.name: MEENOI
influences.context: Number 3 is MEENOI. First of all, I absolutely adore her voice and music in general.
